preconditions.description: The number of nodes (n) and queries (q) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and len(set(a)) == n
preconditions.description: The sequence 'a' is a permutation of integers from 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**6 for u, v, w in edges)
preconditions.description: The input graph is a tree with n-1 edges, each with valid node pairs and weights.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 2 for t in query_types) and len(query_types) == q
preconditions.description: Each query type is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a < 2**30 for a in query_params) and len(query_params) == q
preconditions.description: Each query parameter 'a' is a valid 30-bit unsigned integer.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_line.strip() == str(sum(dist(a[l-1], a[r-1]] for l, r, v in query1_params if t == 1)) for stdout_line, t in zip(stdout_lines, query_types) if t == 1)
postconditions.description: For each query of type 1, the output is the sum of the shortest path distances between nodes a[l] and a[r] in the tree, where l and r are derived from the query parameters.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout_lines) == sum(1 for t in query_types if t == 1))
postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of type 1 queries.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(stdout_line) <= 10**18 for stdout_line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line for a type 1 query is a valid non-negative integer.
